title: Exclusive: Army creates autonomy command amid Hegseth's robo-warfare push
key_facts: The US Army is standing up a new command and a new acquisition office dedicated to autonomous technology, per a service spokesperson and a memo Breaking Defense reviewed.
The memo, dated Thursday (1 Oct 2026) and signed by Acting Army Secretary Adam Telle, orders the Army Futures and Autonomous Systems Command (FASCOM).
It also names a new Program Acquisition Executive (PAE) for Autonomy; today autonomy work sits under Capability Portfolio Executive Mission Autonomy, inside PAE Layered Protection and Integration.
The new PAE must prioritize acquiring and fielding autonomous fires, combat vehicles, watercraft resupply and manned-unmanned teaming no later than fiscal 2028.
The memo orders new "autonomous force development" so force structure fits autonomous capabilities in aviation, armored, sustainment and training formations.
The Army will expand the 15X (tactical drone specialist) and 390A (robotics technician specialist) jobs "to all applicable Army units".
The changes were first reported by Axios and follow Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s new four-star Autonomous Warfare Command (AUTOWARCOM) plan.
quote_evidence: The Army is standing up a new command and a new acquisition office dedicated to further prioritizing autonomous technology, according to a service spokesperson and a memo reviewed by Breaking Defense.
The memo also designates a new Program Acquisition Executive (PAE) for Autonomy.

The changes, first reported by Axios, come on the heels of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth’s newly announced initiatives at the Pentagon to create a new four-star command, called Autonomous Warfare Command (AUTOWARCOM), centered on drones and similar technology as well as a new working group on the future of defense.
why_it_matters_hint: The Army is reorganising its command and buying structure around autonomous systems, with a 2028 fielding target in the memo.
event_date: Memo dated Thursday 1 Oct 2026; first reported 2 Oct 2026
notes: Axios (original, Cloudflare-blocked) could not be read; written from Breaking Defense, which reviewed the memo and quotes an Army statement. Related to Hegseth’s AUTOWARCOM announcement of 30 Sep 2026 (covered in the 1 Oct pool as a separate story). Memo date (1 Oct) is one day before the window, but the news was first public on 2 Oct, so treated as NEW.
